verdict.rationale: Supabase provides a scriptable official CLI that a runtime probe ran keylessly via `npx -y supabase --version`, with `supabase init`/`supabase start` for local stacks. It also offers version-controlled migration files, per-pull-request preview branches, and a Management API with an OpenAPI spec for programmatic project management. Together these clearly support headless and CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions setup or non-interactive token auth for the CLI), and hands-on evidence of a full CI run beyond a version check.
